name: FoodWasteTracker
tagline: Measure every kilo, see where it comes from and cut it – food waste logging, targets and corrective actions in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete food waste app for hotels, restaurants, caterers and bakeries: log waste by item, station, reason and disposal route in seconds, kg and cost with unit conversion, the daily trend against the target, the Pareto of reasons, a station × weekday heat map, station targets and reduction against the baseline, grams per cover, waste % of purchases, diversion rate and CO2e, with verification, corrective actions and food-safety disposal rules. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped and connects to any data source in a few clicks.
features: Log waste in seconds: item, station, reason, quantity, disposal route
Unit conversion g/kg, ml/l, lb/oz, portions; valuation from unit costs
Waste per day against the daily target
Pareto of reasons with the vital few
Station targets and baseline reduction (50 % goal)
Grams per cover and waste % of food purchases
Corrective actions for high-value, large and storage-failure waste
Logged → verified / action required → closed, void and restore with role rules
Drill-down, bulk verify / close / void, undo, CSV export
Power Fx outputs and events (SummaryJson, TicketText)
